The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Skere Kaan]] owned a '''[[flier]]''' that he used during the [[Ruusan campaign|Battles of Ruusan]].

==Behind the scenes==
The comic series initially denoted these vehicles as "flyers"; however, the novel ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]'' and later sources identify these vehicles as "fliers."
